ability.fatecraft.trace.needs_sword: Trace requires a sword in EMIYA's main hand
ability.fatecraft.trace.divine_construct: A divine construct cannot be traced
ability.fatecraft.trace.not_volley: This weapon cannot be volleyed; project it into your hand
ability.fatecraft.trace.emiya_only: Only EMIYA can project traced swords
ability.fatecraft.trace.hands_busy: No empty hand for the projection
ability.fatecraft.sword_body.description: Press: blades pierce out of your body for %1$s seconds. Melee attackers take %2$s%% of the damage they deal, all damage you take is cut by %3$s%%, and you regenerate (Regeneration level %4$s).
ability.fatecraft.project.description.1: Project: puts the sword in your empty main hand. Kanshou and Bakuya fill empty hands.
ability.fatecraft.project.description.2: Trace On: shoots %s copies at your crosshair, paying for each projection.
EMIYA's true-name Noble Phantasm: a fixed, closed sphere of radius %1$s blocks. Opening costs %2$s mana; upkeep is %3$s mana per second (creative is free).

Your traced swords stand in the ground, %4$s of each, at most %5$s, one free projection per slot. In the settings, Ground swords multiplies that count, Ground spread sets how far out from you they stand, and Ground tilt how far they may lean. Inside your active marble, Project and Trace On are free. Offensive copies form and fire only through your firing-mode input.
Incoming Gate of Babylon weapons are opposed by exact copies; craftable countered weapons are permanently traced. Stronger current mana wins overlapping marbles; ties keep the incumbent.
Tap to open; tap again to cancel and restore the original terrain. Releasing a firing mode does not close the marble.

Inside your marble: tap to form a blue sword wall, tap again to fire straight along your look. Hold to keep forming and firing. Shift + press changes the volley tier; the volleys, rate, sword size and spread are set in the ability's settings.
Inside your marble: hold to form and fire sword copies around the crosshair target. Does not use the volley size.
The same blue sword wall; every shot re-aims at the crosshair. Tap to form, tap again to fire, or hold for continuous fire. Shift + press changes the volley tier.
Sword firing requires your own active Unlimited Blade Works
Unlimited Blade Works recovery is pending; casting refused
Unlimited Blade Works is already active or closing
Enuma Elish has broken Unlimited Blade Works; it is crumbling away
Not enough mana to open Unlimited Blade Works
The incumbent marble has equal or greater current mana
ability.fatecraft.rho_aias.description.2: Hold: keeps it up and repairs it with mana.
ability.fatecraft.rho_aias.description.3: Press again while it is up: dismisses it.
ability.fatecraft.excalibur.needs_sword: Excalibur must be in your main hand
Rank A++ Noble Phantasm. Requires true name realization and Excalibur, not Caliburn. Creative ignores true name, mana and cooldown.
ability.fatecraft.excalibur.mode.1.descr: Hold to gather golden light for %1$s seconds. Automatically fires along your current aim when fully charged; keep holding to fire, release to stop. Reaches %2$s blocks, %3$s blocks across widening to %4$s. Deals %12$s damage per second and drains %13$s mana per second.

While held, fires for up to %11$s seconds or until mana runs out. Movement during charge and firing works as it does for Enuma Elish. Turns at the shared beam rate, clashes, carves breakable blocks and stops at shields. %10$s-second default cooldown.
ability.fatecraft.excalibur.mode.2.descr: Hold to gather light for at least %1$s seconds; release to fire at your current crosshair spot, up to %5$s blocks away. A surge of light runs along the ground from you, hitting what it passes over and tearing a furrow, then erupts upwards in a %6$s-block radius, %7$s blocks high.
Deals %8$s damage at the centre, falling to %9$s%% at the edge. Excavates breakable blocks inside the impact radius without drops. %10$s-second default cooldown.
ability.fatecraft.artoria.needs_sword: Hold Caliburn or Excalibur in your main hand.
ability.fatecraft.strike_air.description: Press with Caliburn or Excalibur: instantly blast a rank C wind cone %1$s blocks ahead with a %2$s° opening. Targets are knocked away; you stay in place.
Deflects nearby flying swords and other projectiles during the wind burst. Walls and shields block hits. No true name needed.
ability.fatecraft.mana_burst.description: Press with Caliburn or Excalibur: rank A skill granting +%2$s%% damage to your melee hits, with any weapon or bare-handed, and to Mana Slash, and Speed level %3$s, for %1$s seconds. Letting go of the sword does not end it.
ability.fatecraft.mana_slash.description: Press with Caliburn or Excalibur: swing one golden crescent of light %1$s blocks out across a %2$s° arc in front of you. Available independently of Excalibur's Noble Phantasm; no true name needed.
Press with Caliburn or Excalibur: gather light for %1$s seconds, thrust and fire a rank B shot up to %2$s blocks. On impact, a golden blast strikes within %3$s blocks.
ability.fatecraft.crest_of_the_star.desc: Press: for %1$s seconds, every melee hit is a critical hit, with Speed level %2$s and +%3$s%% attack speed.
ability.fatecraft.photon_ray.description: Rank A Noble Phantasm: requires true name realization. Creative needs neither true name nor mana.
ability.fatecraft.photon_ray.mode.1.desc: Hold for %1$s seconds: opens and spins the held sword. Keep holding: you run forward at %2$s blocks a second, the way you look, and can jump. Letting go before the charge is full cancels it.
Costs nothing to start; while you run it drains %3$s mana a second. Pierces enemies and breaks blocks in the path, except unbreakable blocks. The spinning sword continuously damages enemies in front.
The cone covers you from the front and sides, but its back is open. What you hit is knocked back about %4$s blocks. It ends when you let go, run out of mana or the cone breaks.
ability.fatecraft.teardrop_photon_ray.de: Rank A++ held Noble Phantasm: requires true name realization. Creative needs neither true name nor mana.
ability.fatecraft.teardrop_photon_ray.mo: Hold with Photon Ray in your main hand: opens and turns the held sword tip-down. A red line links it to the sky as circles assemble. Winds up for %1$s seconds.
Aims once at press. Circles and beam stay locked on that spot, even when you turn or move. Light from Mars condenses into a single red beam.
Damages everything within %3$s blocks at the full held-beam rate and digs through breakable blocks without drops.
Lasts while held, up to %2$s seconds of firing. Drains mana while firing; release ends it and starts its cooldown.
Hold with Photon Ray in your main hand: opens and turns the held sword tip-down. Circles assemble at the spot aimed once at press. Winds up for %1$s seconds.
Light spreads from the middle circle to both side circles, then falls as one cyan-white beam covering all three, with a %4$s-block radius and %5$s times Condensed damage per second.
The circles and column never follow your look. Uses the same mana rate and clash rules as Condensed.
Lasts while held, up to %2$s seconds of firing. Drains mana while firing; release ends it and starts its cooldown.
One merged ground blast extends to a %6$s-block radius, falling to zero at the edge. Blocks are dug only inside the beam, without drops.
ability.fatecraft.photon_ray.needs_sword: Photon Ray must be in your main hand
ability.fatecraft.vault.description.1: Press: opens the vault. It costs no mana.
ability.fatecraft.gate_of_babylon.descri: AOE and targeted throw, tap: opens the gates. Tap again to shoot.
AOE and targeted throw, hold: opens the gates and shoots at once, for as long as you hold, the vault's section has items and you have mana.
Shift + the ability button: changes the volley size.
ability.fatecraft.gate_of_babylon.mode.1: Gates open on a wall behind you; weapons fly straight ahead along your look.
ability.fatecraft.gate_of_babylon.mode.2: Follows the crosshair: gates open round the target, or at the block under the crosshair with no target.
Hold: fires. Does not use the volley size.
ability.fatecraft.gate_of_babylon.mode.3: The same wall of gates behind you; re-aims at the crosshair every shot.
ability.fatecraft.gate_of_babylon.player: Only a player can open the Gate of Babylon
ability.fatecraft.enkidu.mode.1.descript: Tap: binds. Tap again to release.
ability.fatecraft.enkidu.mode.2.descript: Hold: tightens the chains, with damage while held; letting go stops it.
With nothing bound, the chains bind first, then tighten; letting go keeps the bind.
ability.fatecraft.enuma_elish.descriptio: Hold with Ea in your main hand: Ea winds up, then the beam fires and lasts while held.
Right-click the key: draws Ea. Right-click it holding Ea: stores Ea again.
Right-click Ea: takes it into your main hand.
Right-click and hold Ea: compressed air destroys everything within %1$s blocks.
ability.fatecraft.enuma_elish.needs_ea: Ea must be in your main hand
